title: nightvisionplus_folia
description: The plugin allows players to have a visually appealing interface in the dark.
body:
This plugin is a rework of the original NightVisionPlus plugin to better suit the Folia server. NightVisionPlus features require the PlaceholderAPI plugin: Provides night vision capabilities.
Commands: /nv <player> (adds/removes night vision for players) /nvp reload, reset (config.yml, PlayerData, all)

Quick Facts: When you enable night vision, it's saved to the PlayerData file, meaning you'll retain night vision even if you die, lose connection, drink milk, or try to remove it with the command (/effect clear).
